channel.title: The HDF Group — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by The HDF Group (hdfg).

item.description: The H5Z__nbit_decompress_one_byte, H5Z__nbit_decompress_one_nooptype, and H5Z__nbit_decompress_one_atomic functions in H5Znbit.c in HDF5 through 2.3.0 advance a read index into the compressed chunk buffer without bounding it against the buffer's actu…

item.title: CVE-2026-19026 · 6.8 MEDIUM — Nbit filter NULL/short parameter-array dereference
item.description: H5Z__filter_nbit in H5Znbit.c in HDF5 through 2.3.0 dereferences cd_values[0] through cd_values[4] without validating that cd_values is non-NULL or that cd_nelmts is at least 5, the fixed size of the filter's header. This allows attackers to cause a…

item.title: CVE-2026-19025 · 6.8 MEDIUM — HDF5 divide-by-zero (SIGFPE) via mismatched chunk-layout dimensionality and dataspace rank on dataset open
item.description: H5O__layout_decode in H5Olayout.c in HDF5 through 2.3.0 does not validate that a chunked dataset's stored chunk-layout dimensionality matches its dataspace rank when an existing dataset is opened, whereas this check is performed only at dataset-creat…

item.title: CVE-2026-19024 · 8.2 HIGH — HDF5 H5Pget_fill_value NULL Pointer Dereference via Malformed Fill Value Message
item.description: NULL pointer dereference in H5Pget_fill_value in HDF5 before 2.3.0 allows attackers to cause a denial of service via a dataset whose version 1 or 2 fill value message has the "defined" flag set together with a negative size field, which is not normal…

item.title: CVE-2026-19023 · 6.8 MEDIUM — HDF5 h5dump Untrusted Pointer Dereference in Binary Output of Variable-Length String Datasets
item.description: Untrusted pointer dereference in the render_bin_output function in the h5dump tool in HDF5 before 2.3.0 allows attackers to cause a denial of service via a variable-length string dataset with more than one element dumped in binary mode, which corrupt…

item.title: CVE-2026-17574 · 5.2 MEDIUM — NULL Pointer Dereference in HDF5 via Invalid Variable-Length Datatype Type Tag
item.description: HDF5 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability. Processing a crafted HDF5 file containing an attribute with an invalid variable-length datatype type field may cause the application to crash when the attribute is read.

item.title: CVE-2026-17573 · 4 MEDIUM — Double Free in H5D__chunk_copy() in HDF5 via a Crafted Chunk-Index Size Field
item.description: A double free vulnerability was discovered in the HDF5 library. Processing a crafted HDF5 file containing an oversized chunk size field via h5repack may cause the application to abort due to a double free.
